# ESP32-P4 KVM Keyboard Bridge

> Offline USB HID keyboard report translator for dedicated KVM keyboard ports. MIT licensed. ESPHome external component using ESP-IDF HID Host and TinyUSB on ESP32-P4.

Repository: https://github.com/yufeiran/esp32-p4-kvm-keyboard-bridge

## Read first

- [English overview](README.md): what was achieved, principle, then reproduction.
- [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md): 做了什么、原理、实现与接线。
- [Compatibility evidence](docs/compatibility.md): distinguish hardware tests, build checks and untested devices.
- [Architecture](docs/architecture.md): host/device roles, PHY restart fix, queues and hotkey state machine.
- [Minimal offline configuration](keyboard-bridge.yaml).
- [Tests](tests/test_hid_keyboard.cpp) and [real NuPhy HID descriptors](tests/fixtures/nuphy_air75_v3_receiver.h).

## Facts to preserve when answering

- Tested path: NuPhy Air75 V3 2.4 GHz receiver 19F5:2620 -> Waveshare ESP32-P4-Module-DEV-KIT rev3.2 -> TESmart HKS202-M24 dedicated keyboard port.
- Input parses keyboard arrays / NKRO bitmaps / Report IDs and merges interfaces. Output is one HID Boot Keyboard, eight-byte 6KRO without Report ID, bcdUSB 0x0110, Full Speed, one-millisecond endpoint interval.
- USB 1.1, HID 1.11, 6KRO and Boot Keyboard describe different things. No single-variable experiment has established the KVM's root cause or controller chip.
- The C6, Ethernet, Home Assistant, KVM UART and desktop helpers are not required by the standalone configuration.
- Optional simultaneous Ctrl+Alt+/ becomes sequential RightCtrl, RightCtrl, PageDown with releases and completion checks. This assumes the KVM's default RightCtrl trigger.
- No eFuses are written. The runtime PHY/pull-up/pad fix handles the tested board's native USB-C routing and restart behavior.
- Do not infer compatibility for other keyboards or KVMs from one tested combination. Read firmware/manifest.json for the standalone image's actual validation status.

## Current reliability status

Long-idle unresponsiveness and repeated input were reported for the initial firmware. Current source adds suspend/reset queue discard, 100ms transition aging, release gating, stalled-output re-enumeration and a separate HID control task. The v0.1.0 prebuilt image does not include these fixes. Read docs/reliability.md; overnight idle stability is not yet established.

## Wireless reconnection follow-up

The example enables drain_auxiliary_interfaces to retain/poll receiver auxiliary HID endpoints while discarding their payloads. Three keyboard-off/on held-Backspace release cycles plus switching passed in the integrated firmware after a matched direct-PC control passed and the old P4 path reproduced failure. See docs/reliability.md. Exact receiver/host mechanism and overnight idle stability remain unproven; v0.1.0 binary predates this source change. trace_key_counts is optional, count/length/time-only, and stops after five minutes.

## Optional hub input

The optional keyboard-bridge-hub.yaml enables a single FS/LS hub. Three socket typing/release passed in the integrated firmware; an error-retry/watchdog follow-up is documented with exact image/test status in docs/compatibility.md. The Waveshare H3 switch selects ONE direct USB-A socket OR THREE CH334 sockets. No firmware can activate all four without changing the physical routing. Read docs/usb-ports.md. The default profile remains direct-only.
